# C# XDK (`XDevPlatform.Xdk` v0.1.2)

> Official C# client library for the X API v2 (.NET 8.0+). Install with `dotnet add package XDevPlatform.Xdk`.

## Guides

- [C# overview](https://docs.x.com/xdks/csharp/overview.md): Overview and quick example
- [C# install](https://docs.x.com/xdks/csharp/install.md): Installation and requirements
- [C# quickstart](https://docs.x.com/xdks/csharp/quickstart.md): Make your first X API v2 request
- [C# authentication](https://docs.x.com/xdks/csharp/authentication.md): Bearer Token, OAuth 2.0 PKCE, and OAuth 1.0a
- [C# pagination](https://docs.x.com/xdks/csharp/pagination.md): Cursor pagination across multi-page endpoints
- [C# streaming](https://docs.x.com/xdks/csharp/streaming.md): Real-time event streams and filtered stream rules

## Client Reference

- [Reference Overview](https://docs.x.com/xdks/csharp/reference/overview.md): Client options and client list
